'''Confederate cush''' is a dish that became popular among the armies of the South during the American Civil War, since it used ingredients that many Southerners had on hand.

==Ingredients==
*Fat [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*[[Cookbook:Cube|Cubed]] cooked [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]]
*[[Cookbook:Cornmeal|Cornmeal]] mush 
*1 [[Cookbook:Quart|qt]] water
*1 clove [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] (optional)
==Procedure==

# Put bacon into a hot iron [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]], and [[Cookbook:Frying|fry]] the grease out of it.
# Add the beef, then slowly add 4 cups of water. Bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]].
# Add cornmeal mush and stir until dry.
# Remove skillet from fire, and let cool.
# Serve warm, like [[Cookbook:Hash Browns|hash]].

==Notes, tips, and variations==
*Can be made with cold [[Cookbook:Southern Cornbread|cornbread]] or soured [[Cookbook:Corn Pone|corn pone]].
*Flour can be substituted for cornmeal.
*Salt pork can be substituted for bacon.
*If more water is added, it can serve as a [[Cookbook:Stew|stew]].
*Crumbled [[Cookbook:Hard Tack|hardtack]] can serve in the place of the cornmeal mush.
*Can be saved for later, like hardtack.
